subject: general
question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

FLO DJM BHK ZFI ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29fb1e6d1432e5da22702af66ed277688d48ad68f3d3ba2e56c35a7a68b05a45.png] 

Logic followed here is.

Logic: Each letter in the word is shifted backward by 2 positions in the English alphabetical order to obtain the corresponding letter of the next word in the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4460225f9f4a596ae7c4aec79fbda40cb25ad1d7c786d50e1aa10604a51dbc52.png] 

 

Therefore, the term that should come in place of the question mark is **XDG**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
